title: Watching Television
content: People hold still when they’re watching television, and that’s a big help to the portrait sketcher.A few days ago in Pittsburgh I had lunch at a restaurant with some friends. There was a TV set hanging from the ceiling near our table.  A golf program captivated my friend’s son. He gazed upward with an angelic look and didn’t move until his hamburger came.In 2003 my son sat like a statue at a diner while waiting for his scrambled eggs.Next time you find yourself in a waiting room or a sports bar, pick the seat near the TV looking back at the watchers. You’ll have your choice of models. If they glance at you, just smile and say “I’m sketching your picture,” and they’ll go back to watching.
